Discoid Lupus Erythematosus: F8: No history of connective tissue disease
F9: No evidence of systemic involvement, such as arthralgia, photosensitivity, or skin rashes
F2: Chief complaint: asymptomatic, arc-shaped, depressed skin groove on the left side of the forehead, frontal scalp, and vertex area
F3: Localized linear hair loss and hair thinning on the left scalp area
F10: Examination revealed 2 long, curved-line, depressed, alopecic patches on the left side of the vertex and frontal scalp area extending to the left eyebrow
F12: Dermoscopic examination of the alopecic area revealed several short vellus hairs, yellow dots, and honeycomb hyperpigmentation
F17: Image C: Scanning view shows predominant lymphocytic infiltrates in perifollicular and periappendageal regions of the dermis and lobular panniculitis (hematoxylin-eosin staining)
F19: Direct immunofluorescence: Positive with granular deposition of IgG, IgA, IgM, C3, C1q, and fibrinogen in the dermal blood vessels
